entries.scope: Enforce MongoDb.WriteEnabled at both shared MongoDB write sinks and fail closed when settings are unavailable
entries.rationale: DE: Die Änderung schließt unbeabsichtigte externe Schreibzugriffe und ändert die dokumentierte TB-06-Kontrolle. EN: The change closes unintended external writes and changes the documented TB-06 control.
entries.navigationImpact: No new navigation path; the existing security register and threat model document the stronger MongoDB boundary.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in synchronized CEFR-B2 evidence text.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Focused unit tests cover configured true/false, fail-closed fallback, compatibility constructor, and pre-database sink returns. MongoDB 8.0.13 provider tests prove zero documents for disabled writes, preserved reads, and one document per enabled sink.
entries.risk: Medium if disabled or unavailable settings still allow external inventory writes.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: MongoDB settings, service construction, write methods, settings fallback behavior, or runtime reconfiguration semantics change.
